# New

### Consolidate
* Added an Offline toggle button to filter offline items.

# Bugfixes
* Fixed an issue where picking up an item manually would cause the Reforge queue to not be cancel/resumable.
* Fixed an issue where clicking on tooltips in Storage Slips would sometimes cause the tooltip to collapse before updating (Show Bags, etc.).
* Fixed an issue where Skirmish augments were not properly saved in some scenarios.
* Fixed an issue wherein listings that sold or expired would not properly show as finished.
